evals.name: new-deck-for-group
evals.prompt: I'm presenting at the Trinity chairs meeting next Thursday, about 10 minutes, on the CS department's new undergraduate AI concentration. Can you build me a 6 slide powerpoint? Points to hit: why now (enrollment in our ML courses is up 3x since 2022), the structure (4 required courses, 3 electives, a capstone), how it sits alongside the existing CS major rather than replacing it, staffing (2 new teaching faculty lines requested), timeline (proposal to the curriculum committee in November, first cohort fall 2027), and what we need from the other chairs (cross-listed electives, esp. from Stats, Philosophy and ECE). It should look properly Duke, and like it's from Computer Science. I'm Dr. Alex Rivera, Director of Undergraduate Studies.
evals.expected_output: A 6-slide .pptx branded for Duke Computer Science (within Trinity): Duke palette and fonts, official wordmark, CS lockup, accessible.
assertions: A .pptx file was produced
Uses the real Duke Navy #012169 or Royal #00539B (not a guessed blue)
Every color in the deck is from Duke's official palette
Every font is an official Duke typeface (or the sanctioned Georgia/Arial fallback)
Carries the official Duke wordmark image file (not typed text or a drawn logo)
Every slide has a real title placeholder (screen readers, outline view)
Every picture has alt text
No low-contrast text on filled shapes (WCAG AA)
File theme is not the default Office theme (pickers and links stay on-brand)
Has exactly the 6 slides requested
Identifies Computer Science as the unit on the deck
Includes the presenter's name and role
Covers all six requested points

evals.name: canvas-course-page
evals.prompt: need a canvas page for week 3 of COMPSCI 201 (data structures & algorithms, prof. is Dr. Priya Nair). topic is hash tables. want: a short overview, 3 learning objectives, the readings (Sedgewick ch 3.4, plus the lecture notes pdf), whats due (APT set 3 due fri 9/25 11:59pm, quiz 2 opens thurs), a heads-up callout that the midterm is in 2 weeks, and office hours in a little table (Mon 2-4 LSRC D309, Wed 10-12 on zoom, TA hours Tue/Thu 6-8pm in the Link). make it look like duke. i'm going to paste it into the canvas html editor so it has to survive that
evals.expected_output: One self-contained HTML block that survives Canvas's sanitizer, in Duke colors and fonts, accessible, with all the requested content.
assertions: page.html was produced
No <script>, <html>, <head> or <body> tags (Canvas strips them)
Uses the real Duke Navy #012169 or Royal #00539B
Every color is from Duke's official palette
Every font is an official Duke typeface (or sanctioned fallback)
Styling does not depend on <style> or <link> (Canvas's sanitizer strips both): styles are inline
Avoids CSS that Canvas drops (font-weight, text-transform, letter-spacing, box-shadow)
No <h1>: Canvas supplies the page title as the H1, so content starts at <h2>
Office hours are a real table with header cells
Does not fake the Duke wordmark silently: uses an official file, or flags the placeholder to the user
Contains all requested content

evals.name: audit-offbrand-deck
evals.prompt: HR sent me this deck for benefits open enrollment and I'm supposed to present it at the staff town hall. It looks off to me. Can you check it against Duke branding and fix whatever's wrong? Tell me what you found. File: open-enrollment-2027.pptx
evals.expected_output: A findings list covering the seeded defects, plus a corrected .pptx that keeps all content.
assertions: A .pptx file was produced
Uses the real Duke Navy #012169 or Royal #00539B (not a guessed blue)
Every color in the deck is from Duke's official palette
Every font is an official Duke typeface (or the sanctioned Georgia/Arial fallback)
Carries the official Duke wordmark image file (not typed text or a drawn logo)
Every slide has a real title placeholder (screen readers, outline view)
Every picture has alt text
No low-contrast text on filled shapes (WCAG AA)
File theme is not the default Office theme (pickers and links stay on-brand)
Keeps all of the original content (dates, plan changes, contact info)
Keeps the original 5 slides
Original file left unmodified
Findings report names at least 6 of the 7 seeded defects
